title: Staging Recovery Storage 驗收與 Rollout 映射矩陣
purpose: 明確分離前置 Storage Readiness（Stage A）與 Release Rehearsal Bundle 實際生成/驗收（Stage B，由 ODP-EPHEMERAL-STAGING-ROLLOUT-001 承接），確保歷史依賴具名承接、執行步驟明確且所有驗收項目與缺口如實披露。

stage_a_pre_deployment_storage_readiness.scope: 核對已合併儲存契約、分離守門規則、GitHub staging 環境變數與身分座標、CMEK/Versioning/Retention/PAP/UBLA/IAM 安全基準、唯讀審計收據及環境綁定前置條件。不執行雲端資源建立或修改。對因 cross-project IAM 權限未授予（非 OAuth token 過期）導致之 GCP 雲端 metadata 唯讀探針誠實記錄 IAM_DENIED 阻擋收據，不偽造運行中物件或通過狀態。

stage_b_release_rehearsal_bundle_lifecyc.phase_name: Stage B: Release Rehearsal Bundle Lifecycle & Drill
stage_b_release_rehearsal_bundle_lifecyc.scope: 於 Ephemeral Staging 部署演練時實際建立短生命週期環境、生成 release-scoped recovery bundle（*.tfvars.json、*.inventory.json、*.lifecycle.json 與 staging-terraform-outputs.json）、上傳至 GCS recovery bucket、驗證 GCS object generation 與 SHA-256 雜湊、執行 backup/restore、Cloud Run traffic rollback 與 rerun identity guard 驗證、並在 watch window 結束後依 exact labels 自動清理。不預設 rehearsal bundle 於 rehearsal 前已存在。注意：snapshot-pointer restore 尚未在 staging_lifecycle.py 實作，列為原 rollout task 之顯式驗收缺口。

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: ODP_STAGING_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_BUCKET 與 ODP_STAGING_TERRAFORM_STATE_BUCKET 必須嚴格獨立，禁止共用同一 bucket 或使用 placeholder 佔位值。
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: check_release_environment.py:285-298, deploy-dev.yml:1218-1222, 1487-1491, tests/release/test_release_environment_precheck.py, RCPT-GH-ENV-VARS-STAGING-002 (distinct bound bucket names)

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: Terraform State Backend Bucket 遵循 State-Only 契約，僅存放 .tfstate 與 lock 物件，嚴禁混放一般 artifact、binary plan 或 recovery bundle。
Recovery Storage 必須啟用 CMEK 客戶自管金鑰加密，綁定 staging runtime KMS Key (oday-staging-runtime)，輪替週期 90 天，prevent_destroy = true。
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: ODP_STAGING_KMS_KEY_ID bound in staging env (RCPT-GH-ENV-VARS-STAGING-002); Live GCP KMS describe probe via runtime SA was denied (RCPT-GCP-KMS-DESCRIBE-001, exit 1, cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get denied). Live metadata remains unprobed on cloud; no pass claimed.

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: Recovery Storage 必須強制啟用 Uniform Bucket-Level Access (UBLA)、Public Access Prevention (PAP=enforced)、Object Versioning 與 30 天 Retention 策略。
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: Security governance standards codified in IaC guidelines; Live GCP bucket describe probe via runtime SA was denied (RCPT-GCP-RECOVERY-BUCKET-DESCRIBE-001, exit 1, storage.buckets.get denied). Live metadata remains unprobed on cloud; no pass claimed.

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: Deployer Service Account 僅被授予 roles/storage.objectUser 權限，禁止授予專案級或儲存桶級 roles/storage.admin。
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: ODP_STAGING_DEPLOYER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT bound in staging env (RCPT-GH-ENV-VARS-STAGING-002); roles/storage.objectUser frozen in deploy contracts; Live GCP bucket IAM policy probe via runtime SA was denied (RCPT-GCP-RECOVERY-BUCKET-IAM-001, exit 1, storage.buckets.getIamPolicy denied). Live metadata remains unprobed on cloud; no pass claimed.

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: 所有儲存檢查收據、log 與錯誤訊息必須遵循 secret_values_redacted=true 不變式，不得輸出真實 secret 值或私密 bundle 內容。
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: tests/release/test_release_environment_precheck.py:test_staging_scope_refusal_receipt_redacts_identical_bucket_values, test_deploy_workflow_contract.py, deploy-dev.yml:1336-1345,1364-1397,1541-1550 (strict artifact allowlists excluding raw dumps and recovery sidecars)

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: 在 Release Rehearsal 建立 ephemeral staging 時，自動序列化 *.tfvars.json、*.inventory.json、*.lifecycle.json 與 staging-terraform-outputs.json 並上傳至 gs://${ODP_STAGING_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_BUCKET}/${staging_backend_prefix}/bundle，並於 hold 狀態時重寫 lifecycle sidecar。

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: 驗證上傳之 Recovery Bundle 具備真實 GCS object generation、SHA-256 content digest 與不可變輸出結構，記錄於 release receipts 中。
criteria_mapping_matrix.historical_pr: Pending execution in parent rollout task
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: During Stage B rehearsal bundle upload, probe uploaded GCS objects (gcloud storage objects describe) to capture and record real GCS location, integer object generation, and SHA-256 content digest for all sidecars into release receipts (staging-lifecycle-create.json / staging-rehearsal-receipt.json). Rehearsal must fail closed if object generation is missing/zero or SHA-256 digest fails verification. Bundles are not created or hash-mocked beforehand.

criteria_mapping_matrix.description: 驗證當 durable state 存在時，重跑必須具備完整 recovery bundle 且所有不可變身分欄位完全一致；否則拋出 ReleaseStateUnverifiable 並拒絕覆寫或錯誤清理；於 verify 階段完成 Cloud SQL backup/restore drill 與 Cloud Run traffic rollback drill（snapshot pointer restore 為顯式缺口）。
criteria_mapping_matrix.historical_pr: Pending execution in parent rollout task
criteria_mapping_matrix.verification_evidence: deploy-dev.yml:1272-1291 (staging_lifecycle.py verify executes rehearsal drills); Cloud SQL backup/restore at staging_lifecycle.py:2904-2942 (exports SQL to gs://${staging_data_bucket}/rehearsal/${release_id}/database.sql and imports back); Cloud Run traffic rollback at staging_lifecycle.py:2943-3076 (creates rollback-probe revision, tests health readback, and restores original approved revision allocation); Closeout bundle readback at deploy-dev.yml:1507-1518 (validates outputs and tfvars identity fields); Rerun protection in staging_lifecycle.py:1550-1631 (validate_immutable_release_identity guards 10 immutable identity fields). summary_disposition.conclusion: 前置 Storage Readiness（Stage A）已於本任務完成代碼契約、分離守門規則、GitHub staging 環境變數座標（2026-09-19 live readback 驗證全部 BOUND）與收據去敏化契約核對；針對 runtime 服務帳號執行 GCP 唯讀探針（OAuth token exit 0）所遭遇之 IAM 權限拒絕（storage.buckets.get, storage.buckets.getIamPolicy, cloudkms.cryptoKeys.get），如實記錄 IAM_BLOCKED 阻擋收據，不假造通過亦不推斷儲存桶缺失。Stage B 之 Release Rehearsal 執行期驗收項目（CRIT-07 至 CRIT-10）已具備可執行命令、流程接點（包含 hold 重寫、generation/hash 探針、Cloud SQL backup/restore 與 Cloud Run rollback）、權限要求、pass/fail 條件與 snapshot-pointer restore 顯式缺口揭露，完整映射至 ODP-EPHEMERAL-STAGING-ROLLOUT-001（Owner: Antigravity5, Reviewer: Codex），歷史依賴完成具名承接。
